messages.subject: Selecting the correct scale_colour functions
parts:
I don't know about others, but sometimes I find myself struggling to
find the right scale to attach to a graph specification.

It is always obvious when you are done, but the process of getting it
right seems somewhat more anguished than I need in my life! It is a
key task, but one I don't always get right. Does anyone else have this
problem (my wife says my cognitive deficits might be extremely
particular!). Does anyone have a strategy for getting it right?

Rob
